operation_details.item: The user completed the customer discovery interviews.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I'm trying to figure out whether to keep refining our MVP or spend more time talking to potential customers before we build anything else.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That sounds like a classic build-versus-learn tension. What has been pulling you toward customer discovery right now?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I decided to focus on discovery. I completed the customer discovery interviews.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Nice, that is a meaningful milestone. Did you have a structured way of running those conversations, or were they more open-ended?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: We had a clear structure before we started. The interview guide is drafted.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good. Having a guide usually keeps the conversation consistent without making it feel scripted. Now that the interviews are done, are you starting to pull out themes?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I'm reviewing the notes now. The synthesis of findings is in progress.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That is often where the real insights show up. Are you seeing any gaps that might require another round of conversations?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, there are a few segments we under-covered. Follow-up interviews are scheduled for next week.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That makes sense. A second round can help validate whether the patterns from the first round hold up across different customer profiles.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. I'm trying to avoid the usual founder move of polishing a pitch deck too early. The raw findings matter more than a clean narrative right now.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That is a good instinct. Many founders rush to investor-ready packaging before the core assumptions are tested, and discovery tends to expose those weak spots.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I'll keep pushing on the synthesis and see what the follow-up conversations add. Thanks for the perspective.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: You are welcome. Once the synthesis is further along, I can help you map the findings to product decisions or future experiments.
